sentences.english: On Sunday it does not rain.
Drita goes to church.
Ardi goes with his grandmother.
The people go into the church.

sentences.text: Në verë ka shumë njerëz në kishë.
sentences.english: In summer there are many people at church.

sentences.text: Edhe Sam, Ana dhe Luan janë në kishë.
sentences.english: Sam, Ana and Luan are at church too.

sentences.text: Fëmijët dhe njerëzit këndojnë për Perëndinë.
sentences.english: The children and the people sing to God.
Ardi likes to sing.
The people sit down.
Then a man speaks.
Sam listens.
He understands a little.

sentences.text: Ana i thotë: — Shumë mirë, Sam!
sentences.english: Ana says to him: "Very good, Sam!"

sentences.text: Sam ka një Bibël në shqip.
sentences.english: Sam has a Bible in Albanian.

sentences.text: Ai e merr Biblën dhe e shikon.
sentences.english: He takes the Bible and looks at it.
He reads a little every day.

sentences.text: Sot ai do të lexojë me Luanin.
sentences.english: Today he will read with Luan.

sentences.text: Luan thotë: — Kjo është fjala e Perëndisë.
sentences.english: Luan says: "This is the word of God."
Sam listens and learns.
He thinks about love.

sentences.text: Pastaj Sam dhe Luan pinë kafe.
sentences.english: Then Sam and Luan drink coffee.
Luan eats bread.

sentences.text: Sam ha një mollë të kuqe.
sentences.english: Sam eats a red apple.
Sam is happy.

sentences.text: Ai mund të lexojë shumë tani.
sentences.english: He can read a lot now.
After church the people drink coffee.

sentences.text: Gjyshja Drita sjell bukë për të gjithë.
sentences.english: Grandmother Drita brings bread for everyone.
Ardi sings with Elira.
Then the people go out of the church.

sentences.text: Ardi dhe Elira luajnë në rrugë.
sentences.english: Ardi and Elira play in the street.
Dritan talks with Sam.

sentences.text: — Kisha juaj është shumë e bukur, — thotë Sam.
sentences.english: "Your church is very beautiful," says Sam.
"Sam, do you read the Bible?"
"Yes, a little every day."

sentences.text: — Shumë mirë. Ajo flet për dashurinë e Perëndisë.
sentences.english: "Very good. It speaks of the love of God."

sentences.text: Gruaja e Dritanit pi kafe me Anën.
sentences.english: Dritan's wife drinks coffee with Ana.
Then Sam goes home.
He prays and reads.
After church Ardi asks Sam:
"What is the Bible?"

sentences.text: — Bibla është fjala e Perëndisë, — thotë Sam.
sentences.english: "The Bible is the word of God," says Sam.
"May I read it?"

sentences.text: — Po. Unë të jap një Bibël.
sentences.english: "Yes. I will give you a Bible."

sentences.text: Sam është në kishë me Anën dhe Luanin.
sentences.english: Sam is at church with Ana and Luan.

sentences.text: Ardi është në kishë me gjyshen.
sentences.english: Ardi is at church with his grandmother.

sentences.text: Njerëzit pinë kafe dhe hanë bukë.
sentences.english: The people drink coffee and eat bread.

sentences.text: Sam flet me Luanin dhe Anën dhe Ardin.
sentences.english: Sam talks with Luan and Ana and Ardi.
